---
title: "Comparing locations"
description: "Outline the distribution of several locations on one plot."
date: 2026-01-01
categories: [comparison]
---

```{python}
#| label: fig-compare-locations
#| fig-alt: "Density outlines for four locations"
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import pandas as pd
import soundscapy as sspy

data = pd.read_csv("../../assets/DemoData.csv")
places = ["CamdenTown", "PancrasLock", "RegentsParkJapan", "RegentsParkFields"]

sspy.density(
    data[data["LocationID"].isin(places)],
    title="Locations compared",
    hue="LocationID",
    density_type="simple",
    incl_scatter=False,
    fill=False,
    diagonal_lines=True,
)
plt.show()
```
